copy:
Rules of Marriage: Unofficial Edition
that nobody tells you
visual: Wide overhead bedroom-living-room hybrid in a warm, real home. Half-folded clothes on a bed corner, one charging cable stretched too far across the room, two used cups, a towel over Zuv's shoulder, Aachu sitting on the floor near a clothes pile, Zuv standing nearby with a helpless amused face. Mildly out of control, not dirty, instantly domestic.
cta_intent: make married couples swipe because the scene feels like their house five minutes before leaving

shot_ladder.primary_action: two people pretend the house is functioning while objects prove otherwise
shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: clothes, cable, cups appear as setup only

copy:
Rule no. 1
The blanket belongs to whoever pulls harder.
visual: Premium top-down bed view. One blanket is pulled from both sides in a cute tug-of-war. Both partners are under the blanket on top of the mattress; messy hair and feet peek out from opposite sides. Hands and wrists clearly emerge from natural shoulder/side positions above the mattress, gripping the blanket corners. No hand, arm, or body part comes from under the bed, floor, or bed frame. One pillow has fallen to the floor. The tug-of-war feels cute and ridiculous, not aggressive.
cta_intent: make couples tag the blanket thief

shot_ladder.primary_action: blanket being pulled from both sides with hands anatomically emerging from on-mattress bodies
shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: bed repeats from slide 1 but camera, action, and visibility change materially

copy:
Rule no. 2
“Bas 5 minute” is legally allowed to mean 45 minutes.
visual: Doorway view. Zuv waits by the open door with keys and a helmet, one shoe on, one shoe missing nearby. Aachu is still choosing between two earrings and slippers near a mirror or shoe rack. His face says he has accepted his destiny; her expression is serious like this is an important national decision.
cta_intent: make partners send it to the one who says five minutes

shot_ladder.primary_action: one person waits while the other is still choosing
shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: new setting and props: keys, helmet, shoes, earrings

copy:
Rule no. 3
There is no such thing as “my snack” after marriage.
role: proof slide and snack theft rule
visual: Night kitchen. The fridge is open and casts a soft dramatic glow. Aachu is caught holding Zuv's hidden chocolate or chips, cheeks slightly guilty but mischievous. Zuv stands silently behind her like a calm detective, one eyebrow raised, not angry. The fridge shelves, wrapper, and hand position clearly prove snack theft. Warm comedy, not shame.
cta_intent: make couples send it as a confession or accusation

shot_ladder.primary_action: one person caught eating the other's hidden snack
shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: new setting; food appears as story proof only

copy:
Rule no. 4
If one person says “nothing,” the case is definitely not closed.
visual: Bedroom side-angle. Aachu faces away with full attitude, sitting upright near the bed edge or blanket corner. Zuv sits beside her, confused and gentle, holding a water bottle or phone like he is trying to decode what happened. The distance is small enough to feel safe. Soft funny tension.
cta_intent: make partners laugh at the nothing-means-something pattern

shot_ladder.primary_action: one person turns away while the other tries to decode the silence
shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: bedroom repeats but action is quiet conflict, not blanket action

copy:
Rule no. 5
One person will remember the fight.
The other will remember what was ordered for dinner.
visual: Premium warm evening dining-table scene after a tiny couple fight. Aachu leans forward mid-rant, expressive hand raised, animated but lovable, not cruel. Zuv sits close enough to show he is listening, but his eyes keep drifting with helpless tenderness toward a steaming plate of momos and a plain food delivery bag because dinner is getting cold. One of his hands rests near the food, the other stays turned toward her, showing he is trying to balance love and dinner. Soft lamp light, real home table, ceramic plates, no brand labels. Observational intimacy: funny, specific, affectionate, and visually richer than a flat table gag.
cta_intent: make viewers send it to the food-focused partner

shot_ladder.primary_action: one person argues while the other worries about dinner cooling
shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: food repeats from slide 4 but moves from snack theft to dinner consequence

copy:
Rule no. 6
Shopping lists are fake.
The basket knows the truth.
visual: Store aisle. A basket sits between them full of random things: chips, candle, socks, chocolate, and one useless cute item. Aachu and Zuv point at each other at the same time, both claiming the other added the items. The basket is centered like the comic villain.
cta_intent: make couples tag the impulse shopper

shot_ladder.primary_action: both point at each other over an incriminating basket
shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: new public setting; basket props are specific to this rule

copy:
Rule no. 7
Marriage is mostly asking,
“Phone kahan hai?”
while holding the phone.
visual: Rebuilt premium living-room setup, not cluttered. Aachu kneels beside a sofa in the lower half of the frame, lifting one cushion with one hand while the missing phone is plainly visible in her other hand, screen dark with no readable UI. Zuv leans from the sofa edge with a patient amused smile, gently pointing at the phone in her hand, trying not to laugh. The room feels lived-in but clean: soft throw blanket, one cup, a small side table, muted plants, warm off-white wall. Clear staged action, clear hand-phone proof, no chaotic pileup, no ugly visual mess.
cta_intent: make viewers instantly recognize and send the phone-in-hand habit

shot_ladder.primary_action: one searches cushions while holding the missing phone
shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: living room returns from slide 1 but action and camera are different

copy:
Rule no. 8
There are no real rules.
Bas ek dusre ki aadat ban jao.
visual: Romantic quiet ending after the chaos. Aachu and Zuv sit on the floor by a sofa near a softly lit window, wrapped in one shared blanket. Aachu leans her head on Zuv's shoulder; Zuv tilts gently toward her, one hand resting over hers near a small shared snack bowl. The room is calm now, with only a few softened traces of the earlier rulebook chaos in the background. Warm neutral ivory light, intimate body closeness, tiny smile, soft belonging. This should feel like observational intimacy and home, not a messy aftermath gag.
cta_intent: make couples save the final slide as the actual thesis

shot_ladder.repeated_prop_check: blanket and snacks return intentionally as payoff
